title: Differential Histone-DNA Interactions Dictate Nucleosome Recognition of the Pioneer Transcription Factor Sox
authors: Burcu Ozden; Ramachandran Boopathi; Ayşe Berçin Barlas; Imtiaz N. Lone; Jan Bednar; Carlo Petosa; Seyit Kale; Ali Hamiche; Dimitar Angelov; Stefan Dimitrov; Ezgi Karaca
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子模拟与DNA足迹实验，系统解析先锋转录因子Sox在核小体上识别DNA的碱基读取与形状读取机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作与动态结合机理，方法为MD模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Pioneer transcription factors (PTFs) have the remarkable ability to directly bind to chromatin for stimulating vital cellular processes. In this work, we dissect the universal binding mode of Sox PTF by combining extensive molecular simulations and DNA footprinting techniques. As a result, we show that when Sox consensus DNA is located at the solvent-facing DNA strand, Sox binds to the compact nucleosome without imposing any significant conformational changes. We also reveal that the basespecific Sox:DNA interactions (base reading) and the Sox-induced DNA changes (shape reading) are concurrently required for the sequence-specific DNA recognition. Among different nucleosomal positions, such a specific reading mechanism is satisfied solely at superhelical location 2 (SHL2). While SHL2 acts transparently to Sox binding, SHL4 permits only shape reading, and SHL0 (dyad) allows no reading mechanism. These findings demonstrate for the first time that Sox-based nucleosome recognition is essentially guided by the distinct histone-DNA interactions, permitting varying degrees of DNA flexibility.
abstract_zh: 先锋转录因子（Pioneer transcription factors, PTFs）具有直接结合染色质以激发关键细胞过程的显著能力。在本研究中，我们通过结合广泛的分子动力学模拟和DNA足迹技术，剖析了Sox PTF的通用结合模式。结果显示，当Sox共识DNA位于面向溶剂的DNA链上时，Sox结合紧凑核小体而不引起任何显著的构象变化。我们还揭示，碱基特异性Sox:DNA相互作用（碱基读取）和Sox诱导的DNA变化（形状读取）对于序列特异性DNA识别是同时必需的。在不同核小体位置中，这种特异性读取机制仅在超螺旋位置2（SHL2）得到满足。SHL2对Sox结合呈透明状态，而SHL4仅允许形状读取，SHL0（二重轴）则不允许任何读取机制。这些发现首次证明，基于Sox的核小体识别本质上受不同的组蛋白-DNA相互作用引导，允许不同程度的DNA灵活性。
